notes.title: Put your hands on the steering wheel !
notes.notes:
[h3]Update 2 is here racers ![/h3]
[h2]
New controller options are available in the options panel:[/h2]

> Vibrations intensity :
[list]
[*] Adjust the power of the rumbles effects of your controller. Can be adjust from 0 (off) to 1 (full power).
[*] Works for gamepads rumbles and steering wheels FFB.
[/list]

> Direct Steering :
[list]
[*]  When "enable", this option disable all the steering filters (steering speed, speed angle versus speed and other internal filters).
[*] The raw input from your controller is applied directly to the wheel of the in game car.
[*] Highly recomended for steering wheels users !
[/list]

[h2]Graphical improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Retuned overall lightings and visual post processing for all tracks and UI.
[*] Refined textured on "Menu" and "Car Select".
[*] Corrected uggly and corrupted materials on some cars (Persche 9070 and Marta MF12).
[/list]

[h2]Minor Bugs correction[/h2]

[list]
[*] VSync option corrected. Now, your VSync is correctly saved.
[*] /!\ It is higly recomentded for all users to enable VSync in the graphical options. The game runs at above 150fps even on low tier hardwares and stuterring can be heavy.
[*] Various minor bugs correction.
[/list]
